mechanism: Both drugs cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure; furosemide induces volume depletion and electrolyte loss while irbesartan blocks angiotensin II-mediated compensation, increasing risk of hypotension, syncope, acute renal failure, and hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and serum potassium regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider dose adjustment of either agent if hypotension or declining renal function occurs.
